# r4.0-pre.12

- The private-key passphrase field keeps focus when startup finishes registering the native workspace. Startup now preserves the displayed connection form, including any text already entered and any focus the user has moved elsewhere.
- Switching to an existing disconnected tab focuses its private-key passphrase field. New-tab focus remains available through the add button and keyboard shortcuts.
- Connected tabs and redraws of the current tab preserve the user's focus. Deferred focus is cancelled when the user interacts or a dialog covers the connection form.

Verified in an isolated Windows WebView2 application, including three launches, repeated tab switching, generated localhost SFTP connection, and settings redraws. This release does not change synchronization behavior.

Prerelease; stable Latest remains r3.6.
